## Gemma 2 9B vs Llama 3.1 8B on the same 42 tune cells

Gemma: imported records of the pre-refactor code (A10G originals; A40 = rescore of the same adapters on the A40). Llama: harness on the A40. Limitation: harness not yet checked against stored Gemma scores.
